name: cold-start-warm-up
title: Cold start and warm-up
description: Records from key-on through a cold start and warm-up at idle until the coolant temperature settles, with the fault codes read at the start and at the end. Start with a cold engine. The person does the work at the car, parked with the handbrake on in a ventilated space.
source: Stated reason: an engine warms until its thermostat opens and then holds the coolant in a narrow band, so the plan ends once coolant temperature has stayed within 2 °C for two minutes, which shows the thermostat regulating; the timeout ends it on a car whose coolant never settles, which is itself a finding.

phases.title: Ignition on
phases.instruction: Parked with the handbrake on: turn the ignition on without starting the engine, wait for the dashboard lamps to settle, then confirm.

when.prompt: Is the ignition on with the engine not running?

phases.title: Start the engine
phases.instruction: Start the engine and leave it idling, parked with the handbrake on, in neutral or P, in a ventilated space.

phases.title: Warm up at idle
phases.instruction: Leave the engine idling, parked with the handbrake on, in neutral or P, in a ventilated space and nobody at the pedals, until the coolant temperature settles.
